problem_statement: Audit the task stop/cancel mechanism and resource cleanup in paperbanana-clean Go implementation, comparing against repo-cn Python reference
constraints: Session state must be recoverable after cancel

findings: No explicit cancel API endpoint in backend
Reliance on HTTP client disconnect for stop detection
All agent Cleanup() methods return nil (stubs)
Python process uses SIGKILL via CommandContext
No graceful shutdown window for Python
No temporary file tracking or cleanup
Canceled sessions are persisted with StatusCanceled
Resume mechanism exists but no UI trigger
Python repo-cn has NO stop mechanism
Go has partial frontend abort support

key_decisions.rationale: Provides automatic cancellation propagation across goroutines
Simple but not graceful, may leave inconsistent state
Interface compliance but no actual cleanup performed

gaps_identified.impact: Users cannot programmatically stop running tasks
Single generation cannot be stopped from frontend
Resources may be left inconsistent on cancellation

recommendations: Add graceful shutdown for Python subprocess
Implement temp file tracking and cleanup
